verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's own release notes announce "Merge issue support", so merging duplicate issues is a first-party capability, though it is evidenced only by a one-line headline. Nothing shows a way to split or unmerge issues the fingerprinter wrongly collapsed. The "issue fingerprint grouping" release concerns how grouping is configured, not splitting existing issues, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: any documented split/unmerge capability, detailed docs on how merging works, independent or hands-on corroboration of merging.

support.subject: As a developer, I can merge issues that are really the same bug and split ones the fingerprinter wrongly collapsed
